maddeler.e:
تبتكروا (form VIII)
# تَبْتَكِرُوا (tabtakirū) /tab.ta.ki.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# تُبْتَكَرُوا (tubtakarū) /tub.ta.ka.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
